strings.categories.6.name: Category C: trucks
strings.categories.6.vehicles: Motor cars (other than those in category D) with a maximum authorised mass of more than 3500 kg; such cars with a trailer of up to 750 kg ⟦41⟧.
strings.categories.6.age: 21 years (art. 74(2)). Exception: from 17, people who have completed training on a referral from the local military administration bodies are admitted to the C test; the licence is issued from 18 (art. 74(3))
strings.categories.6.experience: At least 3 years of experience as a driver, including at least 1 year of driving vehicles of subcategory C1 (art. 74(2))
strings.categories.6.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦42⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦43⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.6.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦44⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦45⟧.
strings.categories.6.practical.vehicle: Truck with a maximum authorised mass of over 3500 kg ⟦46⟧
strings.categories.6.practical.exercises.8: Driving through an uncontrolled level crossing
strings.categories.6.practical.notes.0: The exercise zones of the first stage for categories B, B1, C, C1, D, D1 are listed in para. 38 of the Examination Rules. The order and set of exercises at a particular test ground are set by its layout: the method on 24pdd.kz for Almaty marks some of the zones as “removed”.
strings.categories.6.practical.notes.1: For category C, the 24pdd.kz method gives its own order of zones; some zones at the Almaty test ground are marked as “removed”.

strings.categories.7.name: Subcategory C1E: medium truck with a heavy trailer
strings.categories.7.vehicles: A subcategory C1 motor car with a trailer whose maximum authorised mass is more than 750 kg but not more than the unladen mass of the car, with a total maximum authorised mass of the combination of not more than 12 000 kg ⟦47⟧.
strings.categories.7.age: Not set separately: you need to have held the right to C or C1 for at least 12 months, so usually not before 19
strings.categories.7.experience: At least 12 months of holding the right to drive vehicles of category C or subcategory C1 (art. 74(2))
strings.categories.7.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦48⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦49⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.7.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦50⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦51⟧.
strings.categories.7.practical.exercises.1: Exercises for combinations follow the test ground layout (the list is not published in the Examination Rules)
strings.categories.7.practical.notes.0: For BE, CE, C1E, DE and D1E, para. 39 of the Examination Rules describes only the zone markings: control lines 1.4, yellow broken lines marking the start and end of exercises (width 0.10 m, dash 0.15 m, gap 0.10 m), white “Start” and “Finish” lines 0.4 m wide, lettering 1 m from the lines.
strings.categories.7.practical.notes.1: The practical test is taken on a vehicle of the category for which the licence is issued ⟦53⟧, and separately from the base category ⟦54⟧. We did not find a list of exercises and penalties for combinations in open sources: ask for the layout at the specialised PSC or the training organisation.
strings.categories.7.practical.notes.2: A category CE licence confirms the right to C1E as well (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8)).

strings.categories.8.name: Category CE: truck with a heavy trailer, tractor unit
strings.categories.8.vehicles: A category C motor car with a trailer whose maximum authorised mass is more than 750 kg ⟦55⟧.
strings.categories.8.age: Not set separately: you need to have held the right to category C for at least 12 months, so usually not before 22
strings.categories.8.experience: At least 12 months of holding the right to drive vehicles of category C (art. 74(2))

strings.categories.9.name: Subcategory D1: minibuses
strings.categories.9.vehicles: Motor cars for the carriage of passengers with more than 8 but not more than 16 seats in addition to the driver’s seat; such cars with a trailer of up to 750 kg ⟦63⟧.
strings.categories.9.experience: At least 3 years of experience as a driver, including at least 1 year of driving vehicles of subcategory C1 (art. 74(2): D1 is listed in the same subparagraph as category C)
strings.categories.9.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦64⟧. strings.categories.9.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦66⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦67⟧.
